timeline_model: Upper line: yellow planned/under-development from indicative start, green continuously from dated supporting commit or report through current week (not final staging signoff). Lower line: yellow staging validation from current week until accepted; for no evidenced milestone only upper line remains yellow. No production tasks. Start weeks are indicative planning windows, not attested activity timestamps. Actual milestone dates are supported by the linked commits/reports.
validationRule: Green build milestones persist; yellow staging CHECK rails remain yellow without current-SHA functional evidence and sign-off.
